purpose: Final readiness hardening before a real UI-driven process test that creates a Blazor WASM PWA Tetris app.
postBundleGoal: After this bundle, run a real UI test through the Processes UI using the Blazor app delivery template / Tetris live-run profile.
criticalRisks: A seeded baseline scenario can make a run look completed without exercising real agents.
Agents can still improvise if Blazor/PWA/browser/project-structure/process-artifact skills are not attached to the assigned roles.
A review or QA role must not mutate product files even if it has workspace tools.
A delivery manager/writeback step must use controlled external actions, not product mutation.
The core process runtime must remain generic across business, training, agent improvement, research, and software delivery processes.
